title: object_card
description: EchoForge object_card document. Describes a physical-object archetype (geometry + material variant + dimensions) used as a radar scattering subject. Conforms to the EchoForge strict-open contract: deterministic id, public-proxy provenance, and validation envelope.

id.description: Deterministic EchoForge id of the form ef:<kind>:<public_proxy_id>:<16hex>:1. Derived from the identity-field payload.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator. Always the literal string 'object_card' for this schema.

schema_version.description: EchoForge schema version pin. Must equal '1.0.0' for this revision of the contract.

public_proxy_id.description: Stable, human-readable slug identifying the public-proxy subject (lowercase letters, digits, and ._- separators). Forms part of the deterministic id.

provenance.description: Provenance envelope: how the document was produced, source references, generator, timestamp, and payload fingerprint.

license.description: License envelope (SPDX id and optional notice) under which the object_card content is released.

validation.description: Validation envelope: tier, overall status, uncertainty score, and the per-check results that establish trust in this document.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in tools and reports. Non-empty free text.

object_family.description: Coarse object taxonomy bucket. Examples: fixed_wing_uav | rotary_uav | multirotor | infrastructure | biological | ground_vehicle | maritime | generic. Free-form non-empty string (no strict enum at the schema layer).

geometry_variant.description: Identifier for the specific geometric variant (mesh / parametric shape) used by this card. Non-empty string.

material_variant.description: Identifier for the specific material assignment variant applied to the geometry. Non-empty string.

dimensions_m.description: Bounding-box-style extents in meters along x, y, z. All components are expected to be >= 0.

tags.description: At least one descriptive slug tag (lowercase letters, digits, and ._- separators) used for search and grouping.
